title: Analyst directory record
description: One trusted local analyst record, not a browser-submitted identity or role assignment. Enforce UNIQUE(issuer, subject) across records in PostgreSQL; JSON Schema cannot enforce database uniqueness. Example subjects are synthetic, not provisioned Keycloak accounts.

id.description: Local analyst UUID used by incident assignment and audit.

issuer.description: Validated OIDC iss, matching the configured realm issuer.

subject.description: Validated OIDC sub. Opaque, case-sensitive string; not email or username and not necessarily a UUID.

enabled.description: Local mutation eligibility; login synchronization must not automatically re-enable this record.

AppRoles.description: Allowed roles after backend allowlist mapping of verified ID-token app_roles. Roles are not accepted from request JSON or stored in the directory record.
